information: Please note non-popular events are held on the Saturday. Please check to see if you will actually be required at the venue. You do not need to attend if you are not competing on a particular day however your help judging would be appriciated. Monday is Australia Day public holiday! **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
